newsitem.title: USA: WHX says has no comment now on Dynamics.
newsitem.headline: WHX says has no comment now on Dynamics.

text.p: WHX Corp on Monday said it has no immediate comment as to whether it would boost its takeover bid for Dynamics Corp of America for a third time following Dynamics' statement earlier today that it had rejected WHX's second offer of $45 a share.
"We have no comment on anything at this time," WHX chairman Ron Labow said.
Earlier today, Dynamics said its board voted unamiously to reject WHX's sweetened $45-per share offer to buy another 17 percent -- or 649,000 -- of Dynamics' shares.
WHX, which already owns a 2.9 percent stake in Dynamics, made the sweetened offer last week. On March 31, Dynamics rejected WHX's first offer of $40 per share for the 17 percent stake.
